text:
maria.sales: Heads-up — customer (large financial services) wants a 6‑week on‑prem POC in a fully isolated datacenter. Key asks: signed immutable bundles, offline/airgapped upgrade cadence (monthly or ad‑hoc), license metering with no outbound phone‑home, and completed security questionnaire. They also want the ability to rollback to a previous model bundle if a quantized variant causes regressions.

ryan.eng: doable but need details. We support signed tarball installers and a delta/chunked bundle flow. Offline licensing can work with pre‑provisioned activation tokens or HSM‑backed license blobs. Clarify: by "monthly" do they mean scheduled windows or on‑demand? Large deltas require a 1–2 week lead time for packaging.

jordana.se: ops question — what transfer methods are allowed? USB, SFTP, or a physically delivered catalog? If USB is disallowed we can provide an airgap catalog image and an installer that consumes it. Also need to know how they want config changes applied (manual operator vs ephemeral orchestrator).

alex.k: runtime constraints: quantized model bundles are only forward/back compatible within minor runtime versions. Rolling back across quantization formats may require KV cache invalidation and a cold restart. Recommend we ship versioned bundles + a small compatibility manifest so the installer can refuse unsafe rollbacks. Example verification and install snippet we give to customers: 
```bash
# verify and install (example)
sha256sum redwood-bundle-v1.3.0.tar.gz
sudo redwoodctl install --bundle /tmp/redwood-bundle-v1.3.0.tar.gz --verify sha256:abcd1234...
```

maria.sales: customer said zero external keys allowed — they only accept HSM or customer‑managed KMS. They also asked how licensing works offline: they want a per‑instance license file, signed by us, validated locally with no outbound.

sarah.legal: we can produce signed license blobs with time‑limited activation tokens. Need to confirm export control for the crypto libs in the airgap bundle and add language in the SOW about custody of keys. I’ll attach SOC/Sec questionnaire responses and required clauses.

jordana.se: for canary/upgrades in an isolated site we propose a staged manual rollout: create two node pools (canary + farm). Apply bundle to canary, run smoke tests (we'll provide runbook/test script), then if green, roll to farm. Bundle should include rollforward and rollback scripts for quick operator action.

ryan.eng: note bundle transfer size — customer has a hard 8GB window per transfer. We need to either shard model weights into quantized shards, supply delta patches, or provide a minimal runtime + streaming weight loader. Chunked bundles with an index file are the simplest. Also add checksums per chunk.

maria.sales: pricing question from procurement: are we charging extra for airgap packaging and per‑transfer support? Buyer expects a one‑time packaging fee + monthly retainer for managed patching. I proposed: $12k one‑time packaging + $1.5k/month retainer. Open to feedback.

sarah.legal: pricing ok but we need precise SOW language: "airgap packaging", "signed license issuance", "per‑transfer verification support", and "patch velocity and SLAs". I’ll prepare amendment text.

deploy-bot: [deploy-job#7681] created offline-bundle-release v1.3.0 (sha256:abcd1234) — artifacts available in internal-artifacts (VPN required).

maria.sales: next steps: 1) ask customer for allowed transfer method + exact transfer windows; 2) confirm KMS/HSM model and whether they accept time‑limited activation tokens; 3) deliver draft SOW + pricing; 4) provide runbook + signed bundle. @ryan.eng @jordana.se please add technical checklist items.

ryan.eng: will add compatibility matrix, chunking plan, and offline license validation flow by EOD tomorrow.

jordana.se: will draft the runbook, smoke tests, and example rollback script and post here.

maria.sales: thanks team :thumbsup:
